result.summary: Several visual and layout issues: truncated restaurant names, duplicate cards in the fastest section, cut-off category chips, and incomplete bottom content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu' is truncated and cut off mid-word on the third 'Fastest near you' card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a secondary line so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The first two 'Fastest near you' cards show identical images, titles ('Green Bowl Poké'), times, and delivery fees, looking like a duplicate/bug rather than distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each card loads unique restaurant data; if intentional, differentiate with distinct imagery or labels.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off on the right edge with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add partial next-chip peek, fade, or scroll indicator so users know more categories exist.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, with no visible title or metadata for that listing.
issues.suggestion: Add more bottom padding/scroll space so card titles and details remain fully visible above the tab bar.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over the food images with limited contrast on light plate backgrounds, reducing readability.
issues.suggestion: Increase badge contrast (stronger background/shadow) or reposition so text stays legible on all image types.
